blurb: Guests sail aboard the Endeavor, a US Coast Guard certified vessel, with Captain James Genthner who has over 40 years of experience. Sailing excursions run from May 20th through October 15th. Novice and experienced sailors of all ages can help set sail or relax and enjoy the ride while learning about Nantucket's maritime history.
